scope: actual compiled AI controller and mapper in isolated DOM; byte-identical editable UI source; no user browser/provider/storage writes

tests.name: parent scene contains compact configured summaries and no inline editor for every category field
selection modal searches eligible fields, shows mapped state, and leads to a separate local configuration modal
configuration confirm captures actual DOM text and required checkbox without blur
the same classification field may map to distinct parameters, while duplicate parameters are rejected
new custom supplier columns retain label, number/date types and required independently of classification fields
configuration cancel preserves parent draft and whole-parent cancel performs no persistence or migration
only explicit parent save migrates legacy fields and preserves required without duplicate fixed input definitions
parent save rejects an open child modal instead of writing an unconfirmed field
legacy explicit source and legacy custom parameter merge without losing stricter required
fixed professional parameters expose default system or scene supplier columns before any task import
fixed source reset requires explicit confirmation and restores its independent default column
imported numeric/date types inherit source and datetime remains full text even if disabled select is tampered
parameter validation rejects malformed/reserved keys without losing configuration controls
changed authoritative classification schema prevents parent save and preserves local mappings
reloading changed source definitions invalidates open config without accepting its retained controls
protocol/template changes invalidate a child source choice rather than binding it to a changed fixed parameter
classification change retains scene-specific columns but isolates field references until explicit same-scope restore
supplier switch does not apply another provider mappings and only explicit restore revives its local draft
saved mapping bound to another platform is retained as scoped cache without silently becoming active
out-of-order category reads never overwrite the latest current-scope field list
identity/page/permission changes cannot apply an already-open modal and retain unconfirmed input
refresh/reopen reads only persisted scene configuration, not canceled per-provider drafts
legacy entry redirects into custom configuration while unrelated extract-field operations remain intact
built native hooks collect mapping draft, include it in dirty state and close child dialogs on parent discard
